response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS healtheval, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scan_count, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS gb_per_min_rate FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), a AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_min_rate) AS avg_rate FROM g) SELECT g.healtheval, g.total_scan_count, g.gb_per_min_rate, g.gb_per_min_rate - a.avg_rate AS rate_minus_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE g.gb_per_min_rate > a.avg_rate

assumptions.assumption: The average rate is the unweighted mean of the per-status rates (each status counts once), taken over statuses with a non-null rate. It is not weighted by scan count or by individual scans.
A scan with spanmin = 0 has no defined ratio, so it is treated as missing (NULLIF) rather than causing a division error.
Scans whose site has a NULL healtheval are kept and form their own NULL group, which counts as a status in the cross-status average.
